name: Derivative
definition: Specifies the parameters of a derivative instrument based on a specific asset.

NotionalCurrencyAndAmount.name: Notional Currency And Amount
NotionalCurrencyAndAmount.definition: Amount underlying a financial derivatives contract necessary for calculating payments or receipts.

DerivativeCovered.name: Derivative Covered
DerivativeCovered.definition: Indicates whether the derivative product is covered or not by an underlying financial instrument position.

ExerciseDate.name: Exercise Date
ExerciseDate.definition: Date on which the derivative is exercised.

InterestIncludedInPrice.name: Interest Included In Price
InterestIncludedInPrice.definition: Indicates whether the given derivative price includes a prorated accrued interest component.

NotionalCurrency.name: Notional Currency
NotionalCurrency.definition: Currency of the underlying a financial derivatives contract necessary for calculating payments or receipts.

VersionNumber.name: Version Number
VersionNumber.definition: Number allocated by options exchanges to record that an option has undergone a change in its contract specifications (particularly adjustment of the strike price)

UnderlyingAsset.name: Underlying Asset
UnderlyingAsset.definition: Specifies the underlying asset of the derivative.

Tick.name: Tick
Tick.definition: Minimum price increment with which the contract may be traded.

ExercisePrice.name: Exercise Price
ExercisePrice.definition: Predetermined price at which the holder of a derivative will have to buy or sell the underlying instrument.

Event.name: Event
Event.definition: Describes the state transition of the derivative.
